_comment: CreateFunctionRequest body registering Horizon-RIC's decision plane as an
NVCF function. Gate G10 validates this against the CreateFunctionRequest
schema in the vendored OpenAPI document, so a field that NVCF renamed or
dropped fails CI rather than a deployment.
The choices that are not arbitrary:
apiBodyFormat CUSTOM  - the body is an AgentActionEnvelope, not a Triton
functionType  DEFAULT - the plane answers 202-then-poll, not a stream.
two agree against a real socket.
secrets               - the Ed25519 certificate-signing key is delivered
by NVCF's secret mechanism, never baked into the
configured-but-unreadable path as a hard startup
failure, so a missing secret refuses to boot
rather than signing with a surprise key.
name: horizon-ric-decision-plane
description: Deterministic action-control plane: grades every agent-proposed RAN action against operator-programmed invariants and emits a signed certificate per decision.
